message: I was in the middle of a family outing when my phone decided it was the perfect time to die. Talk about a wake-up call! I realized I hadn’t written down any important numbers or plans, and I felt a little lost without my digital safety net. Now, I keep a small notebook in my go-bag with all our essential info—just in case technology decides to take a break again. Have you ever had a tech hiccup that made you rethink your preparedness?
